tool.description: Native tool or ecosystem integrated by this purifier.

inputs.description: Project files required by the documented quickstart.

lockfiles.description: Lockfiles users must commit; ancillary modified files belong in project instructions.

integration.description: Available integration mechanisms, not a statement that they are interchangeable.

relock.description: Whether running lock again retains already selected versions or digests.

missing_lock.description: Wrapper behavior when no applicable lock is present.

stale_lock.description: Wrapper behavior for invalid or stale locks.

platforms.description: Documented supported Nix systems; does not imply cross-compilation support.

dependency_sources.description: Dependency repository protocols or services covered by this lock.

credentials.description: Authentication supported by the default CLI transport; builder fetcher overrides are separate.

offline_scope.description: Scope of the offline claim after prefetch, not an assertion about unrelated downloads.

offline_limits.description: Inputs or operations outside the lock and prefetch guarantee.

nix_builder.description: Nix attribute path of the project builder.

build_isolation.description: Isolation mechanism used by the Nix project builder, not native host builds.

build_outputs.description: Documented attributes exposed by the project builder result.

editor_diagnostics.description: The supplied language server reports diagnostics in the project context.
editor_diagnostics.label: LSP diagnostics

editor_completion.description: The supplied language server provides completion in the project context.
editor_completion.label: LSP completion

editor_navigation.description: The supplied language server resolves definitions in the project context.
editor_navigation.label: LSP definition lookup

editor_dependency_sources.description: The language server can retrieve source code for locked dependencies; the editor client must support the server's source-retrieval protocol.
editor_dependency_sources.label: Locked dependency sources through LSP

editor_offline.description: Offline operation is available with the integration and setup documented for this project.
editor_offline.label: Offline language-server use

wrapper_required.description: Whether native builds require the wrapper.

named_update_example.description: A native dependency selector used by the named-update example.

supported_native_commands.description: Native commands handled by the supplied integration.

build_engine.description: Native engine used inside the Nix project builder.

editor_metadata_format.description: Project metadata prepared for the editor

lock_identity.description: Identity preserved by the native and companion locks

tested_toolchain.description: Toolchain versions checked by the project.

native_plugin_java_target.description: Java release targeted by the native plugin.

updates_ignore_file.description: Whether locking updates native ignore rules.

projection_incoming.description: Consumes other Nix-built projects through typed repository or resource projections.

projection_incoming_interfaces.description: Nix attributes or arguments used for this projection direction.

projection_incoming_limits.description: Prerequisites, scope restrictions, and unsupported projection paths.

projection_outgoing.label: Outgoing projections
projection_outgoing.description: Exports Nix-built project artifacts through typed repository, shared-library or resource projections.

projection_outgoing_interfaces.description: Nix attributes or arguments used for this projection direction.

projection_outgoing_limits.description: Prerequisites, scope restrictions, and unsupported projection paths.

editor_protocol.label: Language tooling mechanism
editor_protocol.description: Protocol or dependency environment through which language tooling sees the prepared project.

editor_supported.label: Editor integration
editor_supported.description: The reviewed integration supports editor access to the native project environment.
